public_payload.normalized_proposition: GPT-4 frequently fails to reason, if reasoning means reaching valid conclusions from known facts.
conditions: reasoning defined as obtaining valid conclusions from known facts

statement.excerpt: if the definition of reasoning is to obtain valid conclusions from known facts, GPT-4 frequently falls short there, too.

from_speaker: reasoning is to obtain valid conclusions from known facts
our_interpretation: The definition of reasoning fixes what is being assessed; it is not a forecast antecedent.
The ordinary reading is recurring failures to draw valid conclusions from supplied or established premises, rather than merely failures to recall facts.
Frequently requires evidence of recurring errors across a defined collection of relevant tasks. An isolated failure establishes possibility but not frequency.
The target is the original GPT-4 during its March 14–18, 2023 launch period, the latest public model period before the post.
criteria.support_condition: Evaluations attributable to the launch-period model show recurring invalid conclusions on a defined set of tasks whose necessary premises are supplied or established.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad evaluations attributable to that model show consistently valid conclusions on relevant tasks, with failures sufficiently exceptional to contradict the ordinary meaning of frequently.
